title: Initialization Request Contract
purpose: Defines the minimal canonical repository-bootstrap request used by the bounded local initialization workflow.

normative_requirements.text: A repository-bootstrap request shall be one JSON object that explicitly supplies the destination path for the new local repository.
The request root object shall define exactly two required fields in order: `schema_version` as the constant string `2`, then `destination` as a non-empty string; no other root fields are accepted.

The destination shall be the only normal bootstrap choice represented in the canonical request. Product identity, product direction material, source repository, source revision, execution profile, and a separate initialization-authority token shall not be request fields.

The repository name shall be mechanically derived from the final non-empty path segment of the normalized destination. This derivation establishes repository identity only and shall not establish or infer a product identifier.

The destination path shall use the bounded local filesystem path grammar of the initializer, shall contain no U+0000, shall reject URL or remote identities, and shall normalize deterministically to the canonical absolute destination path without environment-variable expansion, tilde expansion, filesystem canonicalization, or symbolic-link resolution.

The canonical request representation shall contain `schema_version` followed by normalized `destination`, encoded as deterministic UTF-8 JSON without insignificant whitespace or a trailing newline; the request fingerprint shall be the SHA-256 digest of those canonical bytes.

Framework source repository and exact revision are execution provenance resolved by the local repo-spec initializer from the framework instance being executed; they shall not be supplied or selected by the repository-bootstrap request.

Repository bootstrap shall not accept product-direction material and shall not establish product overview, product decomposition, product specification, or implementation-plan authority. Those artifacts are successor governed work in the initialized repository.

Request validation shall reject unknown fields, malformed schema_version or destination values, unsupported destination syntax, and any attempt to reintroduce source, revision, product, authority, profile, or direction-material values into the bootstrap request.

The canonical request shall be immutable after validation; local framework provenance resolved by execution shall be recorded separately from the user request and shall not alter the request fingerprint.
